name: Tempo: Video Speed Controller
summary: Speed up or slow down any video or audio on any site with keyboard shortcuts, a small on-video control and per-site memory. Shows how much time you've saved. Free, no ads, no tracking.
description:
Tempo controls the playback speed of every HTML5 video and audio player: YouTube, Twitch VODs, online courses, lecture recordings, podcasts, news sites and anything else that plays in the browser.

**What it does**
- Speed from 0.07x to 16x, in steps you choose
- Keyboard shortcuts on every site: S slower, D faster, R reset (press again to go back), G favourite speed, Z / X rewind and skip ahead, V hide the control. All rebindable.
- A small speed badge on each video with + / - buttons (faint until you hover it, or flash-only, or hidden)
- Remembers your speed per site, or one speed everywhere
- Re-applies your speed when a site resets it on the next video, without fighting you when you pick a speed in the site's own menu (or lock it if you prefer)
- Works inside embedded players and iframes, and in players hidden in shadow DOM
- Leaves live streams at normal speed so they don't stall (pick a speed to override)
- Keeps voices at normal pitch (optional)
- Toolbar badge shows the current speed for the tab
- Time-saved counter: see how many hours faster playback has given back to you
- Turn it off per site with one click
- Works on Firefox for Android: tap the speed badge on a video for the controls

**Free, for real**
Every feature is unlocked for everyone. No ads, no account, no analytics. Settings and the time-saved counter stay in your browser and are never sent anywhere.

If Tempo saves you time and you'd like to say thanks, there's a Ko-fi link in the popup. It's entirely optional and unlocks nothing.

**Permissions**
"Access your data for all websites" is needed so Tempo can find and adjust video players on whatever site you watch. Tempo only touches video and audio elements and its own control; it does not read or send page content.
